renderer: ANGLE (AMD, AMD Radeon 860M Graphics (radeonsi krackan1 ACO), OpenGL ES 3.2)

steps.text:
BOARDING
Go to the back of your Nomad

Use W/A/S/D to walk; drag the view or use the arrow keys to look. Go around the outside of the hull to the rear ramp, behind the engines.

BOARDING
Open your Nomad's rear hatch

Press F to open the hatch and lower the ramp.

BOARDING
Walk up the rear ramp

Use W/A/S/D to walk; drag the view or use the arrow keys to look. Enter the cabin before closing the hatch.

BOARDING
Close the hatch behind you

Press F to close the hatch and raise the ramp.

BOARDING
Walk forward to the pilot chair

Use W/A/S/D to walk; drag the view or use the arrow keys to look. Follow the clear centre aisle to the front of the cabin.

BOARDING
Sit in the pilot chair

Press F to take the controls.

DEPARTURE
Lift off from the station pad

Press B to take off. Wait for the short automatic lift.

DEPARTURE
Retract your landing gear

Press G to stow the legs. Gear down limits you to maneuvering speed.

DEPARTURE
Fly out through the hangar doors

Hold W to move out of the bay. Keep the ship level until you are clear of the station.

YOUR NEXT JOURNEY
Choose what to do next

Press M to select a destination, or press Tab to choose a contract.

YOUR NEXT JOURNEY
Choose what to do next

Press M to select a destination, or press Tab to choose a contract.

APPROACH
Fly toward Patrol signal

Drag the view or use the arrow keys to centre its marker. Hold W to approach; hold X to slow down near it.

NAVIGATION
Reach a clear drive approach

Route blocked by Aeon Orbital. Move to a clear approach. Hold W to fly farther away from the station. Keep Coastal landing selected.

NAVIGATION
Engage the drive to Coastal landing

Press N or J. The ship will brake automatically on arrival.

EN ROUTE
Travelling to Coastal landing

Hold X to abort if needed. Arrival braking is automatic.

ARRIVAL
Lower your landing gear

Press G to deploy the legs before your approach.

ARRIVAL
Descend toward Coastal landing

Drag the view or use the arrow keys to keep the marker ahead. Hold C to descend. Brake as you approach 12 km altitude.

input: Native keyboard; no gameplay state mutation
